carb.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
carb.faq.1.a: Very hard materials, usually based on tungsten carbide and cobalt, used to make cutting tools, drills, milling cutters and wear-resistant parts. Once worn out they are a valuable secondary raw material.
carb.faq.2.q: How will I know the price for carbides?
carb.faq.2.a: We quote individually – the price depends on, among other things, the type, condition and amount of material. Call or write and we will prepare an offer.
carb.faq.3.q: Do you collect material from all over Poland?
carb.faq.3.a: Yes, we operate across Poland and offer door-to-door (D2D) pickup.
